coverageRationale.zh: 把肩窥写成观察攻击的熵模型：看到 k 个字符/位置后剩余多少不确定性，并用移动解锁实验的成功率说明 PIN 与图案的差异。明确实验基线不能直接外推到真实场景。
coverageRationale.en: Formalizes shoulder surfing as an observation-attack entropy model: how much uncertainty remains after k characters or positions are seen, using mobile-unlock experiments to show PIN versus pattern differences. It keeps experimental baselines distinct from real-world rates.

zh: 肩窥：在用户输入认证信息时直接观察、拍摄或录制。
有效熵：攻击者已获得部分信息后，秘密剩余的不确定性。
反馈线：图案解锁时显示已连接点的视觉反馈，便于攻击者跟踪。
观察角度：攻击者视线与屏幕法线的夹角，影响可读性。
en: Shoulder surfing: direct observation, photography or recording while a user enters authentication data.
Effective entropy: the uncertainty left after the attacker has learned part of the secret.
Feedback line: the visual trace in pattern unlock that helps an observer follow the input.
Observation angle: the angle between the attacker's line of sight and the screen normal, affecting readability.

zh.principle: **攻击**：肩窥（Shoulder Surfing）。肩窥是观察攻击：攻击者在你输入 PIN、密码、图案或验证码时直接看、拍或录。它不破解密码算法，而是降低“秘密”的有效熵。设字符集大小 C、长度 L，原始熵 H0=L log2 C。若攻击者看到 k 个位置的准确字符，剩余熵 H_eff=(L-k)log2 C；若只看到这 k 个字符的集合但不知道位置，剩余组合数为 C^(L-k)·P(L,k)，熵为 (L-k)log2 C+log2 P(L,k)。多次观察的经验成功率不是简单独立叠加；若单次成功概率为 p，n 次独立观察可近似 P_n=1-(1-p)^n，但真实攻击有学习效应和角度差异，应用实验基线校准。
zh.why: 移动设备在公共交通、会议室、咖啡厅被肩窥的风险高；6 位 PIN 单次观察 10.8%，多次 26.5%；6 点图案单次 64.2%，多次 79.9%；去掉反馈线降到 35.3%/52.1%。这说明“图案比 PIN 更直观”不等于更安全。肩窥还会泄露验证码、支付密码、聊天内容；对高价值账户，观察一次就足以降低后续暴力或猜测成本。
zh.used: 防护：隐私屏或防窥膜、身体遮挡、在可信环境输入、使用生物识别或硬件密钥、限制屏幕可视角度、随机化键盘、隐藏反馈线、短时验证码。攻击侧：直接观察、手机录像、远摄镜头、屏幕反射、AI 视频分析。防御评估应测不同角度、距离、手机尺寸和手部遮挡，而不是只看单张截图。
zh.broken: 失效：实验室视频与实际场景差异；角度、光线和遮挡；用户快速输入；观察者记忆有限；多因素认证使单次密码泄露不足；但摄像头和慢动作会放大。
zh.history:
肩窥随 ATM、电话亭和移动设备普及而受关注；2017 年大规模在线实验（n=1173）建立移动解锁基线；2019 年研究把不同认证方法的观察难度放在同一实验框架；ACM 2017 论文提供了同行评议记录。后续研究继续比较 PIN、图案、文本密码和图形密码的可观察性。

en.principle: **Attack**: Shoulder Surfing (肩窥). Shoulder surfing is an observation attack: an attacker directly watches, photographs or records a PIN, password, pattern or one-time code as it is entered. It does not break the password algorithm; it lowers the secret's effective entropy. Let the character set have size C and the secret length L. The original entropy is H0=L log2 C. If the attacker sees k exact character positions, the remaining entropy is H_eff=(L-k)log2 C. If the attacker sees the set of k characters but not their positions, the number of remaining strings is C^(L-k)·P(L,k), with entropy (L-k)log2 C+log2 P(L,k). Repeated observations do not simply add independent success. If one observation succeeds with probability p, n independent views approximate P_n=1-(1-p)^n, but real attacks involve learning and angle differences and must be calibrated against experimental baselines.
en.why:
Mobile devices are exposed on transit, in meeting rooms and in cafés. A 6-digit PIN is attacked 10.8% of the time from one observation and 26.5% from multiple observations; a 6-dot pattern is 64.2% and 79.9%; removing feedback lines lowers it to 35.3%/52.1%. “Patterns are more intuitive than PINs” does not mean “more secure”.

Shoulder surfing also leaks one-time codes, payment passwords and chat content. For a high-value account, one observation can be enough to reduce the cost of later guessing or brute force.
en.used:
Defense: privacy screens or films, body shielding, entry in trusted settings, biometrics or hardware keys, limited viewing angles, randomized keyboards, hidden feedback lines and short-lived codes.

Attack: direct observation, phone video, telephoto lenses, screen reflections and AI video analysis. Defense evaluation should test different angles, distances, phone sizes and hand occlusion, not a single screenshot.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
Failure: laboratory videos differ from real scenes; angle, light and occlusion; fast user entry; limited observer memory; multi-factor authentication makes a single password leak insufficient; but cameras and slow motion amplify it.

Adv_A = Pr[Succ_A] − Pr[Succ_ideal]；Cost = D × T × M；Success = 1[advantage > threshold]. Symbols are catalogue-level variables, not standard constants; parameters, test vectors and clauses remain with the registered source. The model states structural relations, not an implementation audit.
en.history: Shoulder surfing gained attention with ATMs, phone booths and mobile devices. A 2017 large online experiment (n=1173) established mobile-unlock baselines; a 2019 study put different authentication methods into one experimental framework; the ACM 2017 paper provides a peer-reviewed record. Later work continues to compare PINs, patterns, text passwords and graphical passwords for observability.
